newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica August inflation 0.96 pct - govt.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica August inflation 0.96 pct - govt.

text.p: Costa Rican consumer price inflation in August was 0.96 percent, down from 1.17 percent in July, the Economy Ministry said Monday in a report.
Accumulated inflation in the first eight months of 1996 was thus 9.1 percent, down from 12.84 percent in the same period of 1995.
Year-on-year inflation in the 12 months through August was 18.51 percent, down from 22.35 percent in the period August 1994-August 1995, the report said.
